paite: Mihai in alungsim in, "Pathian a-om kei," achi a. Akigawp khin ua, thilkihhuaitak ahih ua; thil hoih hih a-om kei uhi.
heading: Lapu Lian A Ding, David La / Mite Gitlouhna / (Sam 53)
english: For the Chief Musician. By David. The fool has said in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt. They have done abominable deeds. There is no one who does good.

paite: Theisiam a Pathian zong a-om uhiam, chi in TOUPA'N van a kipan in mihing tate a-ensuk hi.
english: Yahweh looked down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there were any who understood, who sought after God.

paite: Ahilou lam ah apial vekta ua, nintak in ana om chiatta ua; kuamah thil hoih hih a-om kei ua, khat lel leng a-om kei hi.
english: They have all gone aside. They have together become corrupt. There is no one who does good, no, not one.

paite: Thil hihkhialte tengteng in theihna himhim anei kei ua hia? Tanghou anek bang un ka mite a ne zou vek ua, TOUPA asam kei uhi.
english: Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge, who eat up my people as they eat bread, and don’t call on Yahweh?

paite: Huai ah lau tuntun in a-om ua; Pathian, midiktat suante lak a a-om ziak in.
english: There they were in great fear, for God is in the generation of the righteous.

paite: Mitasam suangtuahnate na selphou ua, TOUPA akihumbitna ahih ziak in.
english: You frustrate the plan of the poor, because Yahweh is his refuge.

paite: Israelte hotdamna Zion a kipan in hong pawt mahleh aw! TOUPA'N amite sal a a-om uh apikik nawn chiang in, huai hun in Jakobte anuam ding ua, Israelte akipakta ding uhi.
english: Oh that the salvation of Israel would come out of Zion! When Yahweh restores the fortunes of his people, then Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.
